notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:

Tiki Man has been included in the all new Chopper Bundle. For the first time Tiki Man and Miner Mayhem are available together on Steam for one amazingly low price.

Checkout the Bundle:

notes.title: Tiki Man trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
We have released the official Tiki Man trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 8 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 4 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Get chopping in Tiki Man and start collecting the trading cards today!
